bull.b: Consistent, sizable free cash flow (FCF) that scaled to ~$497M in 2026 and historically converts ~66%–95% of net income provides durable funding for R&D, M&A, buybacks and debt reduction. High FCF reduces refinancing risk and supports disciplined capital allocation over the medium term.

bull.t: High recurring revenue and client expansion

Changes in rates or client fund balances materially affect reported profitability and cash generation, adding macro-driven volatility to otherwise recurring SaaS economics and complicating forward cash flow visibility.
